# Wiki Compiler

## Overview

The Wiki Compiler is an LLM Wiki [pipeline test](./pipeline-test.md) artifact designed to process raw data files and compile them into structured [documentation](./documentation.md) without requiring an external LLM API key. Operating via a specific [heuristic mode](./heuristic-mode.md), the compiler reads text and markdown sources, extracts topics, and generates Docusaurus-compatible pages complete with automated cross-linking.

## Key Details

- **Heuristic Mode Functionality:** 
  - Reads all `.txt` and `.md` files located under `data/raw/`.
  - Extracts topics locally without needing an LLM API key.
  - Generates final Docusaurus pages under `wiki-app/docs/`.
  - Automatically builds cross-links based on entity mentions (such as [Nova Widget](./nova-widget.md), [TeaBuddy](./teabuddy.md), and [MeshSync](./meshsync.md)).
- **Test Data Layout:** 
  - `data/raw/samples/` contains `[SAMPLE]` prefixed files.
  - `data/raw/dummy-test/` contains `[DUMMY TEST DATA]` labeled files.
  - Incorporates original junk data generated by `generate_junk_data.py`.
- **Known Ingest Quirks:** 
  - Broken markdown exports are used to test parser resilience.
  - Forum HTML scrapes tend to lose nested content.
  - Email threads occasionally include wrong-thread noise.
- **Project Goal:** 
  - Transform 40+ raw files into a rich knowledge graph that surfaces contradictions (specifically regarding attributes like [Battery Life](./battery-life.md), herbal presets, and read intervals).
